Monthly allowance of up to 2,200 PLN (Polish Zlotych) and other benefits

UNESCO/Poland Co-sponsored Fellowships in Engineering 2023 is an opportunity offered by United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) to B.Sc. and M.Sc. degree holders. This fellowship aims to promote human resource capacities in developing countries. The selected candidates will receive up to 2,200 PLN and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree
The selected applicant will receive the following benefits:
A monthly allowance of 1,500 PLN for B.Sc. degree students and 2,200 PLN for M.Sc. degree students
A one-time special allowance of 1,500 PLN for B.Sc. degree students or 2,200 PLN for M.Sc. degree holders will be paid upon arrival in Poland
Air travel ticket (the most direct and economical route) to and from Krakow, Poland
Health insurance of up to US$ 50,000 in accordance with EU requirements for Schengen visa for fellowship beneficiaries who are declared medically fit
One-time special pocket allowance amounting to 120 (one hundred and twenty) US dollars
Two photographs attached to the applications (4x6 cm)
Certified copies of Bachelor’s or Master’s degree/Ph.D. obtained
Two letters of recommendation from someone related to the candidate’s work
The candidatures of the eligible candidates should be submitted by the invited Member State, channeled through their National Commission by following the below-mentioned steps:
' button on the right-hand side of the dashboard and fill in the required details to 'Register'. (Note - If already registered, log in using the registered email Id.)
All the documents must be sent by the invited Member State, channeled through their National Commission by midnight
Note - The applicants are required to register themselves to the Fellowship e-registration system available on the page.
The applicants will be selected based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
Files which are incomplete or which are received after the deadline as well as candidatures that do not fulfil the requirements will not be taken into consideration.
Only the selected candidates will receive a letter through their respective National Commissions for UNESCO.
All applications should be endorsed by the National Commission from the country of the candidate.
